name: create_governance_thread
purpose: Opens a new governance (decision) thread with a first message on a requirement, baseline, roadmap item or roadmap change request of a project.
useWhen: A scope, requirement, baseline or roadmap question/proposal needs an owner decision (GOV-MAX: propose, do not apply).
A blocked activity needs a governance decision (build the payload with prepare_governance_thread_from_blocker first).
The user asked to hold specific queued AISH jobs until a decision is made (blockedAishJobIds, API key only).
avoidWhen: Discussing an activity/issue: threads cannot target activities -> create_comment.
A thread already exists for the same target/anchorKey -> reply_governance_thread (or reply_governance_thread on OAuth).
Proposing the roadmap change itself -> preview_workspace_roadmap_change then submit_workspace_roadmap_change.
How to execute already-approved work (operational detail) -> create_comment on the activity.

inputs.source: list_projects -> id (or list_workspace_projects -> id; get_workspace_decision_inbox -> items[].projectId)

by targetType: requirement -> list_requirements -> id; baseline -> list_requirement_baselines -> id; roadmap-item -> list_workspace_roadmap_items -> id; roadmap-change-request -> list_workspace_roadmap_change_requests -> id (or prepare_governance_thread_from_blocker -> draft.targetId)
inputs.notes: Must exist in this project (requirement not deleted) or in the project's workspace roadmap.
First message; non-empty after trim. OAuth max 20000 chars. Write: context, options, recommendation, decision requested.
Short decision title. OAuth max 500 chars.
Free stable key for dedupe/traceability, e.g. issue:<issueId>:blocker.
API key only (OAuth rejects it). Max 50; each job must be status queued and belong to this project.
Ignored: derived from the target's title/name.

preconditions: Caller may write governance threads: project owner (ownerId or project-owner role), product-owner or delivery-lead governance role, workspace or team manager, or platform admin.
Target exists (see targetId). Roadmap targets need the project to belong to a workspace.
No open thread already covers the same target/anchorKey (check list_governance_threads).
OAuth: scope portfolio:manage (opt-in box 'Gestão de atividades dos projetos').
returns: Plain text (not JSON): 'Governance thread created with ID: <threadId>'. Parse the id after 'ID: '. New thread has status open and messageCount 1.

errors.when: Project <id> not found
errors.fix: Re-read the id from list_projects; do not guess ids.

errors.when: You do not have access to this project
errors.fix: Wrong project or credential; call get_mcp_connection_info and confirm the workspace the key/connector can reach.

errors.when: You do not have permission to create governance threads
errors.fix: Caller lacks owner/product-owner/delivery-lead/manager role. Do not retry; ask the project owner to act or to grant the role.

errors.when: Requirement not found / Baseline not found / Roadmap item not found / Roadmap change request not found
errors.fix: Re-read targetId from the list tool that matches targetType.

errors.when: Unsupported governance thread target
errors.fix: targetType must be baseline, requirement, roadmap-item or roadmap-change-request; for an activity use create_comment.

errors.when: Governance thread content is required
errors.fix: Send non-empty content.

errors.when: Project workspace is required for roadmap governance threads
errors.fix: Project has no workspace; target a requirement or baseline instead.

errors.when: Blocked AISH job <id> not found / does not belong to project <id>
errors.fix: Use job ids from list_aish_jobs for this project.

errors.when: Blocked AISH job must be queued to apply a governance block
errors.fix: Only queued jobs can be blocked; drop that id or ask the user.

errors.when: -32602 Invalid OAuth tool arguments. data.field=<x> data.problem=unknown_field / too_long (OAuth)
errors.fix: Remove fields not allowed on OAuth (e.g. blockedAishJobIds); keep content <= 20000 and title <= 500 chars.

errors.when: JSON-RPC -32003 / insufficient_scope (OAuth connector)
errors.fix: Call get_mcp_connection_info. This tool needs the scope shown in oauthScope; for portfolio:manage the user must remove and reinstall the connector and tick 'Gestão de atividades dos projetos'.

gotchas.text: Not idempotent: a retry creates a duplicate thread; on timeout check list_governance_threads before retrying.
blockedAishJobIds moves those jobs' gate to waiting-approval/governance-decision; resolving or closing the thread releases them to execution-approval (they still need approve_aish_job_execution).
Only add blockedAishJobIds when the user asked to hold those jobs.
Tool description mentions only requirement/baseline, but roadmap targets work too.

verifiedFrom: createGovernanceThreadCommand, canWriteGovernanceThread, resolveGovernanceThreadTarget, normalizeBlockedAishJobIds, appendAishGovernanceThreadBlockUpdatesToBatch, oauthToolPolicy rules

name: create_project_specialist_assignment
purpose: Assigns a registered workspace specialist agent principal to a project under a named accountable human, with a scope statement and an authority boundary.
useWhen: The owner explicitly asked to put a specialist reviewer/advisor agent (risk, security, privacy, architecture...) on a project.
Replacing an assignment: after revoke_project_specialist_assignment, create the corrected one (there is no update tool).
avoidWhen: The agent principal does not exist yet -> create_workspace_agent_principal first (also an owner decision).
An active assignment for the same principal already exists -> list_project_specialist_assignments and reuse it.
Giving a human a project governance role -> not this tool; assignments never grant human authority.

inputs.source: list_projects -> id (or list_workspace_projects -> id; get_workspace_decision_inbox -> items[].projectId)

inputs.notes: Format 'agent:<id>'. Must be active and in the project's workspace. Advisor/reviewer modes only (executor only exists for workspace-owner-copilot).

inputs.source: list_workspace_members -> userId (as chosen by the owner)
inputs.notes: A human user id with read access to the project; never an 'agent:' id.
Non-empty: what the specialist covers on this project.
Non-empty: what the specialist may and may not do (e.g. 'advise only, no approvals').
ISO 8601, must be later than validFrom; omit for open-ended.

preconditions: Explicit owner instruction (this delegates governance scope to an agent).
Caller can MANAGE the project (project owner, project-owner role, workspace or team manager).
Project belongs to a workspace; the principal is active in that same workspace.
API-key profile full or custom (administration write tools are in no other preset); not exposed to OAuth connectors.
returns: The created assignment {id, workspaceId, projectId, agentPrincipalId, specialistType, mode, accountableUserId, scopeStatement, authorityBoundary, conflictDeclaration, independentFromAgentId, requirementId, issueId, governanceThreadId, validFrom, validUntil, reviewCadence, reviewTriggers[], lastRunAt, nextReviewAt, status:'active'|'revoked', createdBy, createdAt, updatedBy, updatedAt, revokedBy, revokedAt} with status 'active'; specialistType and mode are copied from the principal. Keep id for revoke.

errors.fix: Caller cannot manage the project; ask the project owner to do it.

errors.when: Agent principal not found in project workspace
errors.fix: Use an id from list_workspace_agent_principals for the project's workspace.

errors.when: Accountable user must have access to the project
errors.fix: Pick a human who can read the project (list_workspace_members) and confirm with the owner.

errors.when: A human accountable user is required
errors.fix: accountableUserId was empty or an 'agent:' id; use a human userId.

errors.when: Assignment scope statement is required / Assignment authority boundary is required
errors.fix: Ask the owner for the missing text; do not invent it.

errors.when: Archived agent principal cannot receive assignments
errors.fix: Principal is archived; the owner must pick or create another principal.

errors.when: Assignment validity window is invalid
errors.fix: Send ISO 8601 dates with validUntil later than validFrom.

errors.when: An agent cannot be independent from itself
errors.fix: independentFromAgentId must be a different principal.

errors.when: Project workspace is required
errors.fix: Project has no workspace; assignments are not possible there.

errors.when: Tool missing from the tool list (OAuth connector)
errors.fix: Not exposed to OAuth connectors; needs an API-key connection. Call get_mcp_connection_info and tell the user.

gotchas.text: Not idempotent: every call creates another assignment, even for the same principal; list first.
No update tool: to change scope or dates, revoke and recreate.
An assignment never grants human authority (summary always reports humanAuthorityStillRequired=true). Writes an audit event.
